summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the 8 fix points for public mini sites (/c/:slug) and the /admin media form. Verified uniform theme button colors + automatic text/icon contrast in 3 theme combos (white+red, dark bg+light btn, light bg+dark btn), keyboard focus ring, preserved business name, circular avatar below media (no overlap), responsive header video (landscape + portrait, desktop + mobile) with working mute/unmute toggle, removal of the Logo upload, image crop dialog (zoom + drag + confirm/cancel) for profile and cover, video bypassing crop, create/edit save flow, and regression of login/logout, /admin protection, search/status filters and QR Code. 41/44 assertions passed. Only real functional gap found: SEO in pt-BR is NOT implemented (html lang=en, default Emergent title/description, no title fallback to business name).

minor.issue: No HTTP Range support: a request with 'Range: bytes=0-100' returns 200 with the whole body and no Accept-Ranges/206. iOS Safari requires 206 partial responses to play <video>, so header videos may not play on iPhone/iPad and seeking is impossible. Uses no-store cache header too (frontend sets public,max-age=3600 but the edge returns no-store).

ui_bugs.issue: SEO not localized: <html lang="en">, <title>Emergent | Fullstack App</title>, <meta name=description content="A product of emergent.sh">, no og:title/og:description. On /c/agencia-suporte-teste document.title stays 'Emergent | Fullstack App' because PublicCard only sets the title when cliente.seoTitle exists (no fallback to nome) and never sets meta description/og tags.

If the chosen image cannot be decoded/onCropComplete never fires, 'Aplicar e enviar' (image-crop-confirm) stays disabled with no error message or hint — user is stuck with a grey crop area (reproduced with a degenerate 200x300 PNG). Add error state/toast when the image fails to load.

issues: Hover shade lightens the button to rgb(230,65,76); white label contrast drops from 4.76:1 to ~3.97:1 (below WCAG AA 4.5 for normal text). Consider darkening instead of lightening dark themes on hover, or keep hover >=4.5:1.

With object-fit: contain a 9:16 video is letterboxed with black side bars inside the 446px-wide card on desktop (no distortion, but visually heavy). Acceptable per requirement; optionally add a blurred backdrop.

action_items: Implement SEO pt-BR: set <html lang="pt-BR">, a pt-BR default title/description in public/index.html, and in PublicCard set document.title = seoTitle || `${nome} | Cartão digital` plus meta description (seoDesc || descricao) and og:title/og:description/og:image.
Add HTTP Range (206) support + Accept-Ranges to GET /api/files/{path} so header videos play on iOS Safari and can be seeked.
Optional: keep hover button contrast >= 4.5:1 (current 3.97:1 for #E11D2A) and show an error when the crop dialog cannot load an image.
critical_code_review_comments: CardTemplate.jsx: contrast logic is correct (readableOn/isDark) and every action button shares the single .dc-action + corBotoes source of truth — no per-type color overrides remain. Good.

MediaUpload uploads the cropped Blob to the unchanged /api/media/upload endpoint; each MediaUpload instance renders its own ImageCropDialog, so two dialogs can be open simultaneously if one is left open — consider a single shared dialog instance.
serve_file() loads the whole object into memory and returns a full Response; for 25MB videos this is memory-heavy and blocks Range/streaming. Consider StreamingResponse + Range handling.
Admin.jsx is 1021 lines — above the 700-line guideline; split MediaUpload/QRCodeDialog/ClientForm into separate modules.
seed_data_creation: Created published clients via API for contrast/video coverage (kept for re-verification): /c/teste-escuro-botao-claro (#0B0B10 bg + #F5F5F5 buttons), /c/teste-claro-botao-escuro (#FAFAFA bg + #141420 buttons), /c/teste-video-cabecalho (landscape 640x360 WebM header) and /c/teste-video-vertical (portrait 360x640 WebM header, uploaded through /api/media/upload). Temporary client qa-crop-teste (created to validate the save flow) was deleted. Scripts to recreate/cleanup: /app/test_reports/prep_clients.py, prep_video3.py, cleanup_clients.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright's bundled Chromium has no H.264/AAC support, so MP4 header videos show a black box (readyState 0, paused, no error event) in automation only — this is a TEST-ENVIRONMENT limitation, not an app bug. Use WebM (VP8/Vorbis) fixtures: /tmp/landscape.webm, /tmp/portrait.webm (regenerate with imageio-ffmpeg, see /app/test_reports/prep_video3.py). Also note that on MP4 failure the component does NOT fall back to the cover image because no error event fires — worth a UX poster/fallback if desired. Admin login testids are login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (not admin-email-input). admin-nav-* exist twice (hidden desktop sidebar + mobile); on 390px click the visible 'Novo cliente' button instead. For upload tests use page.set_input_files with a real JPEG buffer (a degenerate PNG leaves the crop confirm disabled).
rca_of_the_issue: SEO pt-BR gap: public/index.html still ships the Emergent CRA defaults (lang=en, title, description) and PublicCard.jsx only executes document.title = res.data.seoTitle when the optional seoTitle field is non-empty; seeded clients have seoTitle empty, so the public mini site keeps the English default title/description and no og tags are emitted. /api/files Range gap: serve_file() returns a plain Response with the full body and ignores the Range request header, so no 206/Accept-Ranges is produced.
